reviewContext.userProblem: The finite built-in add-on host catalog omits 12 names used by bundled examples and dispatched by the production adapter; the baseline has 16 unresolvedAddonExecutable failures among 75 examples.
requiredOutcomes: Classify the 12 exact names against actual runtime behavior and add catalog, host-resolution, and deferred-response regressions.
Keep unsupported catalog versions and genuinely unknown names failing closed.
Validate all 75 examples with the built source CLI and classify every remaining failure with exact evidence.
Run targeted Swift tests, SwiftLint, build, independent reviews, final commit and non-force push to the implementation branch.
nonGoals: No live model, network, provider, or gateway calls; deferred gateway entries remain no-op.
No namespace-wide acceptance, new aliases or providers, unrelated refactors, sibling-repository edits, release, or merge.
constraints: Preserve the existing worktree and fix/example-contract-migration branch; use Xcode Swift toolchain and cached dependencies.
Keep scratch and complete command logs under the evidence root, with per-plan and per-attempt subdirectories and final exit codes.
Use source CLI for validation; installed Riela 0.2.1 remains stale until released.
Serialize SwiftPM and shared-tree reconciliation; workers edit their own progress files, not this manifest.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Add exactly 12 explicit version-1 descriptors to RielaBuiltinAddonCatalog because host requirements already consult its finite supports lookup and production adapter dispatch exists.
Keep the two deferred container gateway names visibly classified as no-op; direct adapter tests guard their current envelope and zero gateway calls.
Use injected host capability fixtures to test catalog resolution without executing providers or relying on ambient executables.
intentionalTradeoffs: Catalog membership proves an existing dispatch path, not live provider readiness.
Remaining unrelated example failures may be precisely classified instead of expanded into this minimal fix.

Version 2, unknown riela/ name, and unknown vendor name fail with unresolvedAddonExecutable without package declarations.

outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live gateway, SDK, digest-provider, and chat-provider execution.
Other runtime names beyond the 12 example-driven omissions.
